data.name: Love is Blinds-Custom Blinds, Shades, Shutters

reviews.text:
I knew Dustin, Durrell and Jonathan for years before they owned this business and it is why we chose them to install shades and blinds at my mother’s home & will chose them when we update ours. Their work was exceptional and they are some of the best people I know. They made it so easy and we could not beat the pricing for the quality offered.

Really appreciate y’all!

Great products and great people. Everyone we worked with and talked to was friendly and the project was very smooth. We got cordless blinds for our living room, dining, and kitchen because they needed to be updated. Didn’t realize how big of a difference it would make. We are very pleased and would recommend them.

I cannot say enough wonderful things about our blinds and the service from Durrell! We have the automatic shades both in blackout and standard. As well as the manual ones they are all great quality product. These were a game changer for us and so glad we choose what we did. Durrell was quick to respond, gave us all the options and was great with informing us how to use them. Thank you so much for everything!

I’ve personally known Jonathan and Jake for years. They do a professional job and are highly respectful. They take the time to answer questions and develop customer solutions for every home. I will definitely use them in my next home!

With our home built in the ‘90s it has always been hard to find off the shelf blinds.  The half arch on top made it even harder.

Love Is Blinds came in with a custom solution that was exactly what we wanted and a price that didn’t leave me in shock.

Only order from these guys with whatever your need is!!!

Can’t say enough great things. Easy, no pressure process with great results. The custom blinds have made such a difference in our home. The roller shades make our home more efficient and add a stunning new look! Thanks to Jake and Dustin for all of their hard work. Check them out for your custom blind needs. You won’t be disappointed.

Very professional and friendly. Jake helped us find just what we were looking for and the price was great. We redid the blinds in our master bedroom and living room. We’ll do more windows throughout the house over the next year or so — and we will use Love Is Blinds for sure!
Love is blinds has a great team. They will provide  professional work with a personable process. A team you can trust. I highly recommend them for your next project.

Had a great experience with this company. We did cordless honeycomb shades in our house and love them. The price was right and the employees were easy so work with. I’ve recommended them to several friends.
I had to replace and also repair a few blinds for my offices, and they provided excellent and fast service.   Highly recommend.
Dustin and team are great!  If you need blinds, I highly recommend you give him a call.
The customer service was outstanding, and the product was exactly what we were looking for. They went above and beyond.   We are so pleased with the service we received from this business.
Exceptional service and great price. Dustin is very professional and a pleasure to work with.
Thank you for the great review!
